free_tier.stated: The MAXIO Linux virtual server is 1 core, 2 GB RAM, 100 GB SSD on a 6 Gbps RAID array with 1,200 GB of monthly traffic at KRW 31,500 a month, provisioned immediately. Traffic is billed outbound only, inbound is free, excess is KRW 70 per GB billed the following month, and the vendor states that it does not throttle the port when the allowance is exceeded.

chaining: The no-throttle policy is what makes CLOUDV different from the rest of the Korean market: every other host found either throttles or fails the job at the allowance, and CLOUDV turns an overrun into an invoice instead.
